newsitem.title: NORWAY: Japanese PM arrives for talks with Nordic premiers.
newsitem.headline: Japanese PM arrives for talks with Nordic premiers.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto arrived in Norway on Wednesday for talks with the prime ministers of the five Nordic countries.
The talks are likely to focus on Nordic-Japanese relations in what is Hashimoto's first visit to the region.
He was met at the airport in this picturesque western city by Norwegian Trade and Industry Minister Grete Knudsen and was greeted with polite applause by Japanese tourists at his hotel.

Hashimoto had attended a summit with the European Union in The Hague, where matters ranging from European economic and monetary union (EMU) and Japan's trade surplus to African development and the situation in Cambodia were discussed.
Hashimoto is due to return to Japan on Friday.
